description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- South of 30A- Gulf Front- Community Pool - Professionally Decorated- 3 Adult Bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Sago Sands 202 is a Gulf-front 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom Seagrove Beach condo that sleeps 8. Guests will love the incredible beach views, community pool, private beach access, and wrap-around balcony.This luxurious beachfront condo has sandy-feet-friendly hardwood floors and a relaxed coastal style that takes full advantage of the incredible Gulf views. An entry hall leads past 2 guest bedrooms. Each guest bedroom has a king bed and a private bathroom. The open kitchen, dining, and living space enjoy Gulf views through sliding glass doors that open to a wrap-around balcony. The spacious kitchen has a raised granite counter that seats 4, a farmhouse sink, stainless steel appliances, and lots of space to prepare meals and stash snacks. A mirror framed with oyster shells hangs above a long dining table that seats 6. Coral, seashells, and wooden oars add nautical whimsy to the comfortable living area. Armchairs and a chaise queen sleeper sofa surround a beachy coffee table and a large wall-mounted TV. Guests can unwind and enjoy sweeping views of the Gulf from sliding glass doors that span 2 walls or get some work done at a small writing desk tucked behind the sofa. Stepping onto the balcony, guests can enjoy fantastic views of 30A’s white-sand beach and see the condo’s private dune walkover. Several high-top tables dot the terrace, creating an ideal spot to toast the day or enjoy a mid-day snack. Off the living area is a primary bedroom with a king bed that includes a spacious private bathroom with a jetted tub, separate shower, and a divided vanity. Sliding glass doors in the bedroom open to the balcony.Guests can cool off in the condo’s community pool, located at the north end of the complex, or explore Seagrove Beach, Seaside, and the 30A community on 3 included adult bikes. With Gulf views like these, Sago Sands 202 will book quickly. Call Callista Vacation Rentals today to begin planning your next beach vacation.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa*Weddings are not allowed at this home.
